recommendation.composition: C2: ezno-checker =0.0.18, native Ezno parser + its own checker and imported modules, behind existing owned T00 captured filesystem/identity/supervision/projection adapters; no ts_goport semantic fallback
recommendation.status: plausible distinct hypothesis, prerequisite probe required before bulk adapter work
recommendation.reason: A real native Rust type checker exists, accepts external unmodified definition files through ReadFromFS, retains expression instances/import variable origins and source-backed function IDs. Distinct implementation from C1. API ability does not prove TypeScript 5.9.3 compatibility.
recommendation.not_a_pass: Neither README positioning, a successful build, an AST parse nor a type string is sufficient for SDK-origin/cross-file call target obligations.
recommendation.alternative_stc: STC is a real distinct checker but archived, nightly-2023-10-04 workspace with many unpublished path crates and SWC 0.130.5 parser. It has no demonstrated advantage sufficient to prefer it over a registry-packaged Ezno probe inside remaining effort.
recommendation.alternative_oxc: Oxc parser/SemanticBuilder provides AST/scoping/CFG for a program. The documented API/source inspected does not establish a native cross-file TS type checker reading the SDK. Do not spend C2 on a parser/binder-only substitute; checker.ts compatibility is not evidence of a Rust checker.

vcs_metadata.warning: The published crate is not established identical to the VCS commit. Prefer exact registry artifact plus committed Cargo.lock.

ezno.bundled_parser_requirement: ezno-parser 0.1.7 (upstream caret requirement). Direct consumer pins =0.1.7 if it imports parser APIs; commit Cargo.lock for all transitives. No Cargo resolution performed here.

api.checker: check_project<T: ReadFromFS, A: ASTImplementation>(entry_points: Vec<PathBuf>, type_definition_files: Vec<PathBuf>, resolver: &T, options: TypeCheckOptions, parser_requirements: A::ParserRequirements, existing_files: Option<MapFileStore<WithPathMap>>) -> CheckOutput<A>
api.example: let resolver = |path: &std::path::Path| captured_bytes.get(path).cloned(); let result = ezno_checker::check_project::<_, ezno_checker::synthesis::EznoParser>(entry_points, exact_sdk_definition_paths, &resolver, ezno_checker::TypeCheckOptions { store_type_mappings: true, record_all_assignments_and_reads: true, extra_syntax: false, ..Default::default() }, (), None);
api.sdk_cache_avoidance: Do not include INTERNAL_DEFINITION_FILE_PATH (internal.ts.d.bin) in type_definition_files. That exact name bypasses ReadFromFS and injects Ezno embedded definitions. Passing explicit SDK source paths reads actual bytes through resolver.
api.definition_failure: check_project returns before checking entry modules when definition-file diagnostics contain any error. Therefore SDK-definition loading is a strongly discriminating first probe.
api.mapping: CheckOutput.modules -> SynthesisedModule.mappings and get_instance_at_position; Instance::LValue(VariableWithValue(VariableOrImport, TypeId)); public VariableOrImport has declared_at, MutableImport.of, ConstantImport.to/import_specified_at. FunctionType.id = FunctionId(SourceId,u32). CheckOutput.get_type_at_position only produces a string; it alone cannot establish origin.
api.encoding_risk: Entry source String::from_utf8(...).expect("invalid entry point encoding") is present in upstream. Exact malformed UTF-8/UTF-16 behavior must remain an explicit later prerequisite; do not silently replace units and claim equivalence.
language_risks: TypeCheckOptions intentionally differs from tsc; README explicitly disclaims 1:1 parity and sufficient existing-project support.
Namespace synthesis raises unimplemented diagnostics in published source.
No verified tsconfig/NodeNext/SDK triple-slash dependency closure compatibility; supplying definition files is not proof the intended library closure is selected.

fast_invalidating_probe.budget_proposal: Prepare/build a minimal isolated executable and one SDK-backed source closure first. Initial 45 minutes cumulative effort cap including setup; this is a recommended experiment boundary, not user-approved STOP_BUDGET.
inputs: Exact unchanged TypeScript 5.9.3 SDK bytes already captured for T00, with the same baseline-intended lib closure and entry paths; no simple.d.ts/overrides.d.ts/Ezno cache or handwritten stand-ins.

Public synthetic dep.ts exporting a function returning a string, barrel.ts re-exporting it under another name, and entry.ts importing that name and calling it followed by .trim(). Use exact expected targets already derivable from independent baseline, no reserved input.
observations: Read hook records actual SDK and project paths plus byte hashes; absence of internal.ts.d.bin is enforced by descriptor, no unrecorded OS fallback.
check_project definition diagnostics and whether entry modules were actually checked.

Expression instance and function IDs must resolve through re-export/import to dep.ts declaration and the .trim call to the actual SDK lib.es5.d.ts declaration, including source and offsets; inferred string alone is insufficient.
Keep all diagnostics and missing mappings explicit, and retain process panic/timeout exit evidence.
quick_refutation: Unmodified required SDK closure cannot be parsed/synthesized because a required syntax/feature is explicitly unsupported.
Alias/call/primitive SDK-origin targets are absent or incorrect and no bounded existing API path exists.
A required feature would need a checker subsystem implementation beyond the remaining effort.
fast_invalidating_probe.permitted_followup: If the initial probe fails, inspect the exact failure and at most a bounded owned adapter correction inside the authorized two C2 passes; never edit SDK bytes, shrink the required language/profile, normalize outputs toward expected, or use C1/JS/Go as semantic fallback.
fast_invalidating_probe.interpretation: A proven failed Ezno mechanism rejects this pinned C2 hypothesis under the tested SDK/features and effort budget. It does not establish universal native Rust infeasibility, nor turn unrelated verifier/API gaps into semantic failures.
fast_invalidating_probe.platforms: Local build/probe would be macOS DEV only; selected C2 still needs native Windows/Linux GitHub Actions exact-artifact runs before any READY_TS_NATIVE claim.

oxc.evidence: Official parser guide and current semantic source expose parsing, AST, scoping, references and CFG; no cross-file TS checker API established by these sources. This is a bounded absence of evidence, not proof no such mechanism exists anywhere.

limit: Read-only source survey; no native execution or semantic feasibility verdict. Agent-Reach unavailable in inherited session; official primary web/raw GitHub/registry retrieval used.
